model.name: T21.7: Addresses async OSM-verified
model.description: AddressIndex.mintAddress: store ior:class:Address { oneLine "Country City PostalCode Street HouseNumber", verified:false, osmLink:null, gmapsLink:null } synchronously (never blocks); server enqueues a background VerifyJob that hits Nominatim (limit=1, UA, <=1 req/s, cached by oneLine) and on a hit sets verified:true + OSM + Google Maps links.
